name: Kibanohara Hokoyasu
source:
Major General in the Tokyo Military Police. Head of the Public Order Bureau. Father to [url=/c34598]Kibanohara Ethica[/url].

Originally the leader of the Close Quarters Armed Martial Arts Training Unit, where he contributed greatly to both the development of the Ex-Brain and the refinement of CQAMA as a fighting style.

[Spoiler]Fell deeply in love with [url=/c165927]Nagaoka Takeyuki[/url]. After Takeyuki's death, he extracted genetic information from his corpse and combined it with his own, creating a fertilized egg which [url=/c165799]Aso Yukari[/url] raised in her womb. Thus Kibanohara Ethica was born.[/spoiler]

Said to wear an iron mask, as his face never betrays even the slightest hint of emotion.

[From the in-game profile]
